90.title: XEND-EXT-PAY-001: production checkout + automated license fulfillment for SiteCheck / GridSnip

comments.heading: SiteCheck release gate — consolidated action from merchant audit
Incident: Google OAuth callback Error 1101 — emergency rollback
Google OAuth owner login recovery follow-up
SiteCheck + PayU + Chrome Store — unified launch checkpoint

verified: PayU domestic merchant activated; PAYU_KEY/PAYU_SALT exist as encrypted Worker bindings (names only).
Production Worker pinned to stable #334 (version 994d2f01) after the Error 1101 rollback; public SITECHECK_PRO_CHECKOUT_ENABLED absent (OFF); owner pilot flag set.
Extension manifest on main is v2.0.0; a tested v2.0.0 ZIP exists as CI artifact (run 41479903724). No v2.1 source on main (v2.1 work is draft PR #108).
PayU hashing, captured verification, idempotent entitlement, licence and refund code exist on main (PRs #92, #98, #99, #105).

remainingBlockers.text: Rotate the exposed Google OAuth web client secret in Google Cloud; set exact redirect https://www.xendersecrets.com/api/auth/oauth/google/callback; replace plain_text GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET bindings with encrypted secret_text in Cloudflare.

Release the dedicated-OAuth build (draft PR #104) as an isolated version; smoke-test /account, /api/health, /api/auth/providers, /api/payu/config with checkout OFF; owner Gmail login + /api/auth/me; roll back to #334 on any failure.
Owner-only ₹499 canary purchase: captured payment, webhook/callback, exactly-once entitlement, Pro licence in Chrome, reinstall restore, full + partial refund, GST receipt, settlement.
Submit the exact tested v2.0.0 ZIP to the Chrome Web Store with matching privacy/listing/reviewer notes; record approval.
Enable public INR checkout only after B1–B4 and first-purchase fulfilment are verified; flag OFF immediately on 5xx/failed entitlement.
